name: The Harem Garage
source:
You're not handsome, you're not book smart. Your family don't have money, and you're never gonna be a sports star. But there's one thing you're damn good at: driving cars. That's your dream, to become a professional race driver. All you need is a chance to make a name for yourself, to be a winner for the first time in your life. The first step is to break into the local underground scene... and then become the fastest street racer around. Strap in, bucko, we're going for a ride!

[From [url=https://f95zone.to/threads/the-harem-garage-v0-18-cyberturul.252877/]F95 Zone[/url]]
translation:
你不帅，也不聪明。你的家人没有钱，你永远成不了体育明星。但有一件事你非常擅长：开车。这就是你的梦想，成为一名职业赛车手。你所需要的只是一个让自己出名的机会，成为你人生中的第一次胜利者。第一步是闯入当地的地下场景……然后成为周围最快的街头赛车手。系好安全带，Bucko，我们要去兜风了！

[来自[url=https://f95zone.to/threads/the-harem-garage-v0-18-cyberturul.252877/]F95区[/url]]
